values.name: KE_VARIANT_ENTITY
values.doc: An entity of the world the component lives in: the only place a component holds one.

values.name: KE_GPU_COMPARE_UNDEFINED
values.doc: No comparison (default for samplers without shadow compare)

enums.name: ke_gpu_shader_language
enums.doc: Shader source language a device accepts. Query via `ke_gpu_device::shader_language`.

enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

structs.name: ke_vec3
structs.doc: Three floats, x then y then z.

structs.name: ke_vec4
structs.doc: Four floats, x then y then z then w.

structs.name: ke_quat
structs.doc: A rotation; the four lanes are x, y, z, w.

structs.name: ke_transform
structs.doc: Spatial transform: where a thing is, how it is turned, and how big it is.

structs.name: ke_variant_table_entry
structs.doc: One authored key and its value. Whoever accepts the key sets `consumed`; the loader reports every entry left unclaimed.

structs.name: ke_component_field
structs.doc: One field of a component: where it lies, what a scene writes into it, and the names an integer field may be written as.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The name a scene writes the field by.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: What the field holds when nothing authors it. KE_VARIANT_NULL means the header declared no default and zero stands.

fields.name: enum_names
fields.doc: The names a scene may write for an integer field, in value order; a name stands for its index. None leaves the field numeric.

fields.name: enum_count
fields.doc: Entries in `enum_names`.

fields.name: copy_bytes_per_row_alignment
fields.doc: Byte multiple a texture/buffer copy's bytes_per_row must be a multiple of; 1 when the backend imposes none.

fields.name: z_zero_to_one
fields.doc: True when clip z is in [0,1] (Vulkan/D3D/WebGPU), false for [-1,1] (GL).

fields.name: y_flip
fields.doc: True when a top-left framebuffer origin needs a Y flip in projection.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional name shown for this object by capture and validation tools; copied by the call.

fields.doc: Optional name shown for this object by capture and validation tools; copied by the call.

fields.name: initial_data
fields.doc: Optional. Tightly-packed RGBA8 pixels (mip 0 only).

fields.name: initial_data_size
fields.doc: Byte size of initial_data.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: shader bytes in the device's accepted language (query ke_gpu_device::shader_language); WGSL text or SPIR-V binary etc.

fields.name: byte_size
fields.doc: size in bytes (excluding any text terminator)

structs.name: ke_gpu_vertex_buffer_layout
structs.doc: One vertex buffer of a pipeline.

fields.name: write_mask
fields.doc: bitmask: bit 0=R, 1=G, 2=B, 3=A

fields.name: view_dimension
fields.doc: For TEXTURE bindings: KE_GPU_TEXTURE_DIM_CUBE selects a cubemap binding; any other value (incl. zero-init) is a 2D texture.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Optional name shown for this object by capture and validation tools; copied by the call.

fields.doc: NULL → "main"

vtables.name: ke_completion
vtables.doc: Work that finishes once, with a result: a job, an asynchronous operation, a read, a run, a submission. Whoever received it releases it exactly once; a completion that another call borrowed as a dependency is released only after the work that depends on it completed.

slots.name: poll
slots.doc: Whether the work finished; callable from any thread.

params.name: out_result
params.doc: Receives what the work finished with, when it finished.

slots.name: wait
slots.doc: Blocks until the work finishes and returns what it finished with. Callable from the thread that created the system the completion came from, and from inside a job when the completion came from that job system.
slots.return_doc: What the work finished with; KE_RESULT_NOT_SUPPORTED, at once, from any other thread, where the completion is passed as a dependency instead.

slots.name: release
slots.doc: Gives the completion back; the pointer is invalid afterwards. The work itself is not stopped.

vtables.name: ke_gpu_command_encoder_handle
vtables.doc: Owns a command encoder: destroy releases it, whether or not it was finished.

vtables.name: ke_gpu_command_buffer_handle
vtables.doc: Owns a finished command buffer: destroy releases it, after it was submitted or instead.

slots.name: queue_submit
slots.doc: Submits the command buffers to the queue, in order.

slots.name: queue_poll
slots.doc: Runs this device's event pump without blocking: delivers the callbacks of work that has completed since the last pump (create_render_pipeline_async, map_buffer_read).

slots.name: create_buffer
slots.doc: Creates a buffer. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_buffer
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_texture
slots.doc: Creates a texture. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_texture
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_texture_view
slots.doc: Creates a view of `tex`. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_view
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_sampler
slots.doc: Creates a sampler. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_sampler
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_shader_module
slots.doc: Creates a shader module. The backend's reason for rejecting the source is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_module
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_render_pipeline
slots.doc: Creates a render pipeline. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a color target without a format, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_pipeline
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_compute_pipeline
slots.doc: Creates a compute pipeline. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_pipeline
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_bind_group_layout
slots.doc: Creates a bind group layout. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_layout
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: create_bind_group
slots.doc: Creates a bind group. The backend's reason for a rejection is logged.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the backend rejects the object.

params.name: out_group
params.doc: Receives the object; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

slots.name: destroy_pipeline
slots.doc: Releases a pipeline made by create_render_pipeline or create_render_pipeline_async.

slots.name: create_command_encoder
slots.doc: Creates a command encoder.

params.name: label
params.doc: Name shown by capture and validation tools; copied by the call.

params.name: out_encoder
params.doc: Receives the encoder; left zeroed on failure.

slots.name: query_extension
slots.doc: Returns a typed extension vtable by name, or NULL if unsupported.

slots.name: shader_language
slots.doc: Shader source language this device accepts in create_shader_module.

slots.name: get_ndc_convention
slots.doc: Clip-space convention this backend expects projections built in.

slots.name: create_render_pipeline_async
slots.doc: Kicks a background pipeline compile — the driver compiles off the caller's thread; `on_ready` fires later (during this device's normal event pump, e.g. at queue_poll) with the finished pipeline, or a failure code and KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE. No caching and no fallback.

slots.name: flush_pipeline_compiles
slots.doc: Blocks until every pipeline compile kicked via create_render_pipeline_async has invoked its on_ready callback. Call before destroying anything an in-flight callback might still write into. A no-op if nothing is pending.

slots.name: map_buffer_read
slots.doc: Starts mapping [offset, offset + size) of a buffer created with KE_GPU_BUFFER_USAGE_MAP_READ for reading. `on_ready` fires later, during this device's normal event pump (queue_poll, queue_wait_idle), with KE_OK when the range is readable through map_buffer until unmap_buffer. Submit the work that writes the buffer before calling.

slots.name: destroy_compute_pipeline
slots.doc: Releases a pipeline made by create_compute_pipeline.

vtables.name: ke_render_frame
vtables.doc: The frame every pass declares into: the render graph's frame, begun with the frame's colour, depth and output, and executed and presented once the passes are declared. Each resource it answers is one of the frame being declared, valid until the next frame begins.

slots.name: frame_cid
slots.doc: The tag every system that declares a pass writes, which puts those systems in a series, and that the systems beginning and ending the frame touch.

slots.name: graph
slots.doc: The graph the frame's passes are declared into.

slots.name: live
slots.doc: Whether a frame is being declared; when not, a pass declares nothing.

slots.name: color
slots.doc: The frame's colour, which the passes up to KE_RENDER_STAGE_HDR_POST draw into; cleared when the frame begins.

slots.name: depth
slots.doc: The frame's depth, cleared when the frame begins.

slots.name: output
slots.doc: The texture the frame is presented from, imported from the render target, which the passes from KE_RENDER_STAGE_TONEMAP on draw into.

slots.name: claim_output
slots.doc: Says that a pass declared in this frame writes every texel of the output from the colour; without it, the frame copies the colour into the output at KE_RENDER_STAGE_TONEMAP.

slots.name: publish
slots.doc: Publishes resource under name for the passes declared after it in this frame; a name published again is replaced. What a frame published is forgotten when the next begins.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a NULL name; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

slots.name: find
slots.doc: The resource published under name in this frame; KE_RENDER_GRAPH_RESOURCE_INVALID when none is.

slots.name: color_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the colour the frame begins with.

slots.name: depth_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the frame's depth.

slots.name: output_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the frame's output.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK, or the code of the compile that failed, whose reason is logged.

lanes.name: pso
lanes.doc: The pipeline; KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE when the compile failed.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_buffer_mapped_func
callbacks.doc: Receives the outcome of mapping a buffer for reading.

lanes.name: result
lanes.doc: KE_OK when the range is readable through map_buffer until unmap_buffer, or the code of the mapping that failed.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_record_fn
callbacks.doc: Records a pass, possibly on another thread and after add_pass returned, through ctx only.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_condition_fn
callbacks.doc: Whether a pass runs this frame; asked once, at compile.

callbacks.name: ke_render_graph_readback_fn
callbacks.doc: Receives the bytes of a resource the pass declared READBACK, once the frame retires.
